name: Temporary ULNs - Race
description: A different provider (UKPRN 10005078) first POSTs and waits for a short course on a different course code (ZSC00002) for the temporary/placeholder ULN 9999999999, so a learner record already exists under that ULN. Then Provider 10005077 fires two more POSTs without waiting for a response - Alan Alpha (learnerRef TEMPULN-01) and Beth Bravo (learnerRef TEMPULN-02), both on course ZSC00001 - to provoke a race condition between two different learners sharing the placeholder ULN against an existing record from another provider on a different course.

steps.name: SLD Create Short Course - Temporary ULN (9999999999), Different Provider And Course, Establishes Learner Record
SLD Create Short Course - Temporary ULN (9999999999)
SLD Create Short Course Again - Same Temporary ULN, Same Course
